observation: Holds clinical observations (one row per observation) with keys id, identifier and subject and measures/attributes including code, category, status, effective, issued, value, interpretation, referenceRange, bodySite, method, performer, device, specimen, related, component, comment, dataAbsentReason, language, implicitRules, meta, text, basedOn.
immunization: Holds immunization events (one row per administered or recorded immunization) with keys id, identifier and patient and measures/attributes including vaccineCode, status, date, notGiven, primarySource, lotNumber, expirationDate, site, route, doseQuantity, performer/practitioner, location, manufacturer, encounter, reportOrigin, explanation, reaction, note, vaccinationProtocol, shr_action_PerformedContext_extension, implicitRules, language, meta, text.
procedure: Holds procedures (one row per procedure/procedure occurrence) with keys id, identifier and subject and measures/attributes including code, status, performed, notDone, notDoneReason, category, bodySite, performer, reasonCode, reasonReference, context, location, outcome, complication, complicationDetail, followUp, focalDevice, usedCode, usedReference, note, partOf, definition, shr_action_PerformedContext_extension, implicitRules, language, meta, text.
organization: Holds organizations (one row per organization) with keys id, identifier and measures/attributes including name, active, type, alias, partOf, address, contact, telecom, endpoint, language, implicitRules, meta, text.
allergy_intolerance: Holds allergy/intolerance records (one row per asserted allergy/intolerance) with keys id, identifier and patient and measures/attributes including code, clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, category, criticality, type, onset, lastOccurrence, asserter, assertedDate, recorder, note, reaction, implicitRules, language, meta, text.
care_plan: Holds care plans (one row per care plan) with keys id, identifier and subject and measures/attributes including status, intent, title, description, category, context, period, author, basedOn, careTeam, addresses, supportingInfo, goal, activity, partOf, replaces, note, language, implicitRules, meta, text.
explanation_of_benefit: Holds explanation of benefit records (one row per EOB) with keys (implicit) id, insurer, claim/claimResponse links and measures/attributes including disposition, outcome, totalBenefit, unallocDeductable, payee, precedence, processNote, related, item/addItem, procedure, prescription, hospitalization, facility, information, employmentImpacted, enterer, form, language, implicitRules, meta and many bluebutton StructureDefinition extension fields (StructureDefinition_bluebutton_..._extension).
diagnostic_report: Holds diagnostic reports (one row per report) with keys id, identifier and subject and measures/attributes including status, code, category, effective, issued, performer, result, conclusion, codedDiagnosis, imagingStudy, specimen, presentedForm, image, language, implicitRules, meta, text, basedOn, context.
basic: Holds simple/basic records (one row per basic resource) with keys id, identifier and measures/attributes including code, subject, author, created, language, implicitRules, meta, text.
patient: Holds patient records (one row per patient) with keys id, identifier and measures/attributes including name, birthDate, gender, deceased, address, telecom, contact, managingOrganization, generalPractitioner, link, multipleBirth, maritalStatus, communication, photo, birthPlace, us_core_birthsex, us_core_ethnicity, us_core_race, various shr_* and disability_adjusted_life_years/quality_adjusted_life_years extensions, implicitRules, language, meta, text, active.
imaging_study: Holds imaging studies (one row per imaging study) with keys id, identifier, uid and patient and measures/attributes including accession, availability, status (implicit), started, numberOfSeries, numberOfInstances, procedureCode, procedureReference, modalityList, description, interpreter, referrer, reason, endpoint, series, context, basedOn, language, implicitRules, meta, text.
claim: Holds claims (one row per claim) with keys id, identifier and patient and measures/attributes including type, subType, status, use, provider, organization, insurer, priority, payee, billablePeriod, created, total, diagnosis, procedure, item, information, originalPrescription, prescription, referral, related, accident, hospitalization, employmentImpacted, fundsReserve, facility, language, implicitRules, meta, text.
condition: Condition — one row per recorded clinical condition/diagnosis for a patient (subject). Keys/identifiers: id, identifier. Notable attributes/measures: code, category, clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, severity, stage, onset, abatement, assertedDate, asserter, context, bodySite, evidence, note, text, language, meta, implicitRules.
goal: Goal — one row per care plan goal or objective for a patient (subject). Keys/identifiers: id, identifier, expressedBy. Notable attributes/measures: description, category, priority, start, status, statusDate, statusReason, outcomeCode, outcomeReference, target, note, text, language, meta, implicitRules.
encounter: Encounter — one row per healthcare encounter/visit. Keys/identifiers: id, identifier, partOf, episodeOfCare. Notable attributes/measures: class, classHistory, type, status, statusHistory, period, length, reason, diagnosis, participant, appointment, incomingReferral, hospitalization, location, account, serviceProvider, priority, text, shr_action_PerformedContext_extension, meta, implicitRules, language.
practitioner: Practitioner — one row per healthcare practitioner/person. Keys/identifiers: id, identifier. Notable attributes/measures: name, gender, birthDate, address, telecom, communication, qualification, photo, active, text, meta, language, implicitRules.
medication_request: Medication_request — one row per request/ordering of a medication for a patient (subject). Keys/identifiers: id, identifier, groupIdentifier. Notable attributes/measures: status, intent, medication, authoredOn, requester, recorder, subject, context, reasonCode, reasonReference, dosageInstruction, dispenseRequest, priorPrescription, substitution, detectedIssue, supportingInformation, eventHistory, category, priority, note, text, shr_action_RequestedContext_extension, shr_base_ActionCode_extension, meta, implicitRules, language.
